messages:
Asha: Weekend pulse check — whos free Sat afternoon? Thinking picnic at Lakeside Park around 1pm, or a casual brewery crawl downtown. Vote with 'park' or 'brew'! :sun_with_face: :beer:
Ben: park for sure. I can bring a frisbee and a portable speaker. :frisbee: :headphones:
Marcos: brew sounds fun but I'm allergic to grass pollen, so park might be rough for me. If it's park and there's a shady spot, I can swing by.
dev-bot: Reminder: Lakeside Park permits picnic groups up to 10 without reservation.
Asha: Noted. quick tally: park = Asha, Ben; brew = none yet; Marcos tentative for park if shaded. Anyone want to bring sandwiches or a dessert?
Ben: I'll bring sandwiches (vegan option included). Also can bring a blanket.
Marcos: I can bring bottled water and individual hand fans (heat wave prep).
Asha: Sweet. Plan: Lakeside Park, Shelter B (near the big oak) at 13:00. If it rains, fallback is The Rusty Tap at 14:00. I'll post an update Sat morning.
Ben: Sounds perfect. See you at 1!
Marcos: Thanks for thinking of allergies—I'll bring antihistamine just in case.
Asha: GIF time: https://giphy.com/gifs/picnic-joy-xyz789 :sparkles:
__notes: Single Slack thread stored as one string; messages are chronological and prefixed with display names. No title field included per agents.md.
